base.name: Helios Commerce
base.description: Fictional multi-region commerce platform. Every service, metric and incident is synthetic.

candidate.name: Helios Commerce
candidate.description: Fictional multi-region commerce platform. Every service, metric and incident is synthetic.

recording.name: DDoS Surge, on Helios Commerce
recording.description: Run of a comparison of platforms on helios-commerce with seed 42.

phases.name: Probing
phases.description: Low-rate probes map the public API surface.

events.title: Unusual request pattern at the edge

phases.name: Volumetric surge
phases.description: Request volume climbs to several times the gateway's capacity. Latency rises and requests are shed.

phases.name: Edge mitigation
phases.description: Rate-based rules at the edge router drop traffic from the offending sources before it reaches the gateway.

phases.name: Attack subsides
phases.description: The flood loses intensity while filtering stays in place.

phases.name: Recovery
phases.description: Traffic returns to its normal shape and services recover.
